meta.title: Kiran AB — Tech Lead & Full-Stack Engineer
meta.description: Senior Tech Lead with 10 years of full-stack expertise in Java Spring Boot, ReactJS, AWS and Kafka. Building scalable core banking and enterprise systems at ANZ.

profile.name: Kiran AB
profile.tagline: Crafting scalable systems that power institutional banking — one microservice at a time.
profile.availability: Open to senior engineering & leadership roles
summary: Software Engineer with 10 years of experience designing, developing and operating enterprise cloud-native applications across institutional banking and global automotive systems.
Strong hands-on expertise in Java 17, Spring Boot, microservices, ReactJS, TypeScript, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, OpenShift, Apache Kafka and PostgreSQL.
Proven record of owning end-to-end delivery across architecture, technical design, development, testing, code reviews, CI/CD, production support and engineering mentorship.
Experienced in modernizing legacy platforms, designing distributed and event-driven systems, optimizing application performance and integrating heterogeneous enterprise systems.

Strong foundation in Generative AI and modern AI application concepts, including LLM application patterns, AI-agent architectures, structured prompting, context management, RAG, embeddings, vector search and Model Context Protocol (MCP), with a strong interest in applying these capabilities to secure, scalable enterprise software platforms.

experience.summary: Tech Lead, Designer and Full-Stack Developer in the Institutional Banking department, responsible for developing and maintaining core banking web-based applications for ANZ's institutional bankers.
highlights: Architect and develop backend microservices using Java Spring Boot with a focus on scalability and performance.
Design and implement responsive frontend solutions using ReactJS.
Manage DevOps operations including CI/CD pipeline optimisation and deployment automation.
Mentor junior developers and conduct technical code reviews to maintain code quality.
Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Implement cloud-based solutions using AWS services for improved scalability and reliability.
achievements: Led the ORION project refactoring, modernising legacy banking systems with the latest technology stack.
Optimised application performance, delivering a 40% reduction in response times.
Implemented event-driven architecture patterns using Kafka for real-time data processing.
Established best practices for microservices development and deployment, adopted as the reference architecture for future ANZ projects.

experience.summary: Full-stack software developer responsible for gathering requirements from stakeholders and delivering rich, user-friendly web applications with a core focus on API integration and specification-driven development.
highlights: Gathered requirements from stakeholders and translated them into technical solutions with rich, user-friendly UIs.
Developed and integrated RESTful APIs across frontend and backend layers.
Built and maintained frontend applications using Angular 4 and ReactJS.
Designed Angular structures and models for organised, maintainable application architecture.
Collaborated with cross-functional and global teams to ensure system reliability and quality.
Maintained high code quality and adherence to development standards throughout the delivery lifecycle.
achievements: Awarded the SPOT Award for outstanding dedication and commitment to excellence.
Awarded the Volvo IT Star Award for technical excellence and innovation.
Runners-up in Hackathon 2017 and Hackathon 2018 (Volvo IT Ignite).
Developed multiple mission-critical applications supporting global Volvo operations.

projects.name: ORION
projects.overview: ORION is a pivotal core banking application within ANZ Institutional Banking undergoing comprehensive refactoring — rebuilt from the ground up using advanced technology stacks to modernise legacy systems and establish a new architectural standard.
responsibilities: Served as Tech Lead and Designer, setting technical direction and architectural standards for the project.
Architected a microservices-based backend using Spring Boot and AWS services.
Implemented Kafka-based event streaming for real-time transaction processing.
Spearheaded development of user stories and technical implementation planning.
Oversaw the DevOps process, including CI/CD pipeline improvements and cloud deployment.
Contributed to knowledge-sharing initiatives, enhancing overall team productivity.
Demonstrated end-to-end ownership from development through production deployment.
Mentored junior developers on microservices architecture and cloud best practices.
projects.impact: Resulted in minimal defects post-release and established ORION as the reference architecture for future ANZ projects.

projects.name: NAMS — New After Market Service Integration System
projects.overview: A centralised integration system for Volvo aftermarket operations. The NAMS Information Center (NIC) provides comprehensive real-time visibility of NAMS operations, clients, and subsystems.
responsibilities: Led frontend development using ReactJS with a focus on performance and usability.
Designed and implemented visually appealing, intuitive graphical user interfaces.
Developed real-time status monitoring and alerting systems for downstream subsystems.
Handled full-stack API development and seamless front-end integration.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure system reliability and data integrity.
projects.impact: Delivered a centralised operational dashboard adopted across Volvo aftermarket teams, reducing manual monitoring effort.

projects.name: VDA+ — Vehicle Data Administration
projects.overview: A central Volvo system providing unified access to vehicle information across Volvo Trucks, Volvo Buses, and Mack Trucks — enabling read/write access to VDA data, VIC card printing, and report generation.
responsibilities: Developed the frontend using Angular 4 with a focus on robust data handling and user experience.
Integrated APIs and implemented functional components per stakeholder specifications.
Designed Angular structures and data models for a well-organised application architecture.
Liaised directly with stakeholders for requirements gathering and implementation sign-off.
Ensured high code quality and long-term maintainability across the codebase.
projects.impact: Provided a unified vehicle data interface for Volvo Trucks, Buses, and Mack Trucks globally.
